title: Microfinance Competition in the Presence of Moneylenders: Theory and Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.12186v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: After decades of microfinance expansion and despite charging higher interest rates, moneylenders continue to exist alongside microfinance institutions (MFIs). We develop a dynamic model with ex post moral hazard, in which borrowers use MFI loans for production and can rely on moneylenders for bridge loans after shocks to repay MFIs and preserve future access to MFI credit. We then study how MFI competition shapes the coexistence between MFIs and moneylenders. The effect of competition on MFI credit is ambiguous: it may weaken repayment incentives or replace moneylenders as bridge lenders. By contrast, competition unambiguously reduces moneylender credit. In a village-level randomized expansion in Bangladesh, stratified by baseline MFI presence, one additional MFI reduces the number of moneylender loans by roughly 30-40% two to three years later, with no detectable effect on MFI or overall borrowing. translated_title: 高利贷者存在下的微型金融竞争：理论与证据
translated_abstract: 经过数十年的微型金融扩张，尽管收取更高的利率，高利贷者仍然与微型金融机构（MFI）并存。我们建立了一个具有事后道德风险的动态模型，其中借款人使用MFI贷款进行生产，并在遭受冲击后可以依靠高利贷者的过桥贷款来偿还MFI贷款，从而保持未来获得MFI信贷的资格。随后我们研究了MFI竞争如何塑造MFI与高利贷者之间的共存关系。竞争对MFI信贷的影响是模糊的：它可能削弱还款激励，也可能取代高利贷者成为过桥贷款提供者。相比之下，竞争明确地减少了高利贷者的信贷。在孟加拉国一项按基线MFI存在情况分层的村庄级随机扩张实验中，每增加一家MFI，会使两到三年后的高利贷贷款数量减少约30-40%，而对MFI借贷或总体借贷没有可检测到的影响。
tldr: 该研究通过事后道德风险动态模型与孟加拉国村庄级随机实验证明，微型金融机构的竞争对自身信贷的影响不明确，但会明确使高利贷贷款数量减少约30-40%，从而解释了两者长期共存的市场结构。
en_tdlr: Combining a dynamic ex post moral hazard model with a village-level randomized experiment in Bangladesh, this paper shows that MFI competition has ambiguous effects on MFI credit but unambiguously reduces moneylender loans by roughly 30-40%, explaining the persistent coexistence of the two lenders.
